title: KestrelCare Labor Time Guide: Diagnostic Hours by Vehicle System
content:
| Vehicle system of the repair | Diagnostic hours on a KestrelCare repair order |
|---|---|
| engine | 2.0 (powertrain diagnostic hours) |
| transmission | 2.0 (powertrain diagnostic hours) |
| electrical | 2.5 (electronic diagnostic hours) |
| high-tech electronics | 2.5 (electronic diagnostic hours) |
| hybrid or electric drive system | 2.5 (electronic diagnostic hours) |
| any other system | 1.0 |

**Rule.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair order, the diagnostic hours follow the vehicle system of the repair: a repair on the engine or the transmission is paid the powertrain diagnostic hours; a repair on the electrical system, the high-tech electronics or a hybrid or electric drive system is paid the electronic diagnostic hours; a repair on any other system is paid one hour.

The vehicle system is the one on the plan's most recent approved claim decision entry, the decision whose diagnostic time is being paid.

*Hypothetical:* a diagnosed transmission failure is allowed 2.0 hours, a failed hybrid drive inverter 2.5 hours, a cooling system repair 1.0 hour.
